blocks.text: Sculptures honoring North Korean soldiers who fought in the Vietnam War are set to be installed in Hanoi, Pyongyang’s state media reported Monday. A ceremony unveiling the monument’s foundation plaque was held Friday at the Vietnam Military History Museum in Hanoi, the Korean Central News Agency said. North Korea is believed to have sent close to 400 soldiers to Vietnam during the war, including 90 pilots between 1966 and 1969.
